dishes.name: Golden Smoky Bean Bowls
dishes.title: Smoky black bean and sweet potato chilli with brown rice
dishes.method: Assemble the bowls by combining the pre-cooked smoky black bean chilli and brown rice. Top with freshly chopped coriander and a squeeze of lime juice.
dishes.why: A smoky, protein-rich bowl that satisfies the house request for slow-cooked depth using only the hob to keep the oven free.

dishes.name: Charred Summer Vegetable Chilli
dishes.title: Smoky black bean chilli with roasted courgettes and peppers
dishes.method: Reheat the smoky black bean chilli and the roasted vegetables together in a wide pan over a medium heat for 8 minutes until bubbling and hot. Serve with a squeeze of lime.
dishes.why: This warm dinner features charred loud vegetables and smoky beans, meeting the coach's requirement for a warm element at the end of the day.

preparations.title: Smoky Black Bean & Sweet Potato Chilli (Lunch Batch)
preparations.method: Sauté diced onion and garlic in olive oil. Add diced sweet potato, smoked paprika, and chipotle paste. Stir in tomatoes and beans with a splash of vegetable stock. Simmer for 30 minutes until the potato is tender and the sauce is thick and smoky.

preparations.title: Smoky Black Bean & Sweet Potato Chilli (Dinner Batch)
preparations.method: Cook alongside the lunch batch in the same large pot following the same method. This ensures a consistent slow-cooked depth of flavour.

preparations.title: Steamed Brown Rice
preparations.method: Rinse the rice and boil in salted water for 25-30 minutes until tender. Drain well and fluff with a fork.

preparations.title: Charred Courgettes & Peppers
preparations.method: Slice the courgettes and peppers into thick chunks. Toss with olive oil, salt, and pepper on the single oven tray. Roast at 200°C for 25 minutes until softened and charred at the edges.

cooking_sessions.run_through: Start the rice on the hob. While it boils, chop all vegetables. Sauté the onions and sweet potatoes for the large batch of chilli in one big pot, then add the beans and tomatoes to simmer. Arrange the courgettes and peppers on the single oven tray and roast them. Once the rice and chilli are done, divide the chilli into lunch and dinner portions and box everything up.

member_portions.portion_note: Serve the roasted vegetables first, then the smoky black bean chilli, and finally the brown rice.
Place the smoky black bean chilli and brown rice on the plate first, then add the roasted vegetables.
Arrange the smoky black bean chilli and brown rice first, then top with the roasted vegetables.
Serve all components together, mixing the smoky black bean chilli with the rice and roasted vegetables.
